page.overview:
Who is Foot Ninja?

Foot Ninja (sometimes named Foot Soldier) are a common enemy in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles video games. They often carry different weapons, such as bo staffs, bow & arrows, and katanas, although they typically do not take on different appearances/colors as their did. The exceptions would be Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3: Mutant Nightmare (which had gray, purple, and red Foot Ninja), Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Arcade Attack (which had gray, blue, and red Foot Ninja), and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Double Damage (which added yellow Foot Ninja). These instances appeared to be deliberately invoking the multi-colored Foot minions of yesteryear.

Foot Ninja appear in the fourth area of Stage 1: Things Change and become a common enemy fought in all stages except 2 and 5, as well as the first and final training missions. There are only two types of Foot Ninja available to fight:

Additionally, both versions of Foot Ninja can dodge attacks by backflipping. In Stages 4 and 6, Foot Ninja may also pilot a small hovercraft. These enemies are referred to as Foot Bees.

Initially appearing in Skyscraper alongside the , Foot Ninjas are some of the first enemies encountered—and also being some of the weakest; they can be defeated instantly by picking them up and throwing them into a wall. While they behave very similarly to their previous console appearance, they do come with some minor differences:
